title: The skills check-tickets and write-tickets overlap. Merge them, or keep both with sharper descriptions?
context: The catalog overlap check scored check-tickets against write-tickets at 0.43 (Jaccard over description and triggers), at or above 0.4. Both are discover-journey step skills in runtime/claude-plugin/skills whose descriptions share the same opening and closing phrasing. Only the owner decides merges.

options.label: Merge into write-tickets

options.trade_off: You give up: a separate skill for check-tickets's step, and its name in the journey.

options.label: Keep both, sharpen descriptions
options.one_line_preview: If you pick this, both stay and their descriptions are rewritten so they no longer read alike.
